Matt LaCroix joins Danny Jones to argue that the world's oldest written text hints that humans did not start on Earth. LaCroix studies very old texts and lost history. His claim rests on how he reads those first writings.

LaCroix walks through the old lines he says point to a sky-based start for our kind. He links the texts to gods who came down and shaped early life. Jones asks which lines carry the claim and how scholars read them instead. Listeners hear the off-world origin case in full. The library keeps the talk as an archive record, without judging the reading.
